item.text:
**8B.8 Assessment:** Mixed, leaning positive on administrative and macro-policy correction, weak on security/accountability and political cleanup. Jokowi did show some real course correction in 2024, especially after cyber failures and in core economic and health systems. But in Papua and in patronage/election politics, the record shows more continuity than corrective adaptation.

**Positive / corrective**
- [After a major cyberattack, Jokowi ordered an audit of government data centres](https://www.scmp.com/news/asia/southeast-asia/article/3268495/jokowi-orders-audit-indonesias-data-centres-after-cyberattack) - Reuters via South China Morning Post, 2024-06-28. Claim: after a serious service failure, he did not just deny the problem; he changed method toward audit and review. IDs: `8B.8`, also `8B.6`, `8B.5`.
- [President urges BPKP to audit national data center governance](https://en.antaranews.com/news/317175/president-urges-bpkp-to-audit-national-data-center-governance) - ANTARA News, 2024-06-28. Claim: the response explicitly shifted to governance audit, which is direct evidence of correction rather than stasis. IDs: `8B.8`, also `8B.5`, `8B.6`.
- [Indonesia's tax agency probes alleged personal data breach](https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/indonesias-tax-agency-probes-alleged-personal-data-breach-3622634) - Reuters via Investing.com, 2024-09-19. Claim: the state moved from exposure to investigation and mitigation when the NPWP breach surfaced, showing reactive adaptation. IDs: `8B.8`, also `8B.5`, `8B.6`.
- [Presiden Jokowi minta perlunya mitigasi soal kebocoran data NPWP](https://www.antaranews.com/berita/4345027/presiden-jokowi-minta-perlunya-mitigasi-soal-kebocoran-data-npwp) - ANTARA News, 2024-09-19. Claim: Jokowi directed Kominfo, Finance, and BSSN to respond quickly, which is concrete cross-agency course correction. IDs: `8B.8`, also `8B.5`, `8B.6`.
- [IMF staff completes 2024 Article IV mission to Indonesia](https://www.imf.org/en/news/articles/2024/06/14/pr24221-imf-staff-completes-2024-article-iv-mission-to-indonesia) - IMF, 2024-06-14. Claim: the macro framework remained prudent, credible, and shock-ready, suggesting Jokowi’s economic team adapted through disciplined policy rather than collapse or denial. IDs: `8B.8`, also `8B.5`, `8B.7`.
- [Indonesia Economy Projected to Remain Resilient](https://www.worldbank.org/en/news/press-release/2024/06/24/indonesia-economy-projected-to-remain-resilient) - World Bank, 2024-06-24. Claim: policy credibility and prudent macro management helped keep growth resilient, implying the government could sustain and adjust its economic approach under constraint. IDs: `8B.8`, also `8B.5`, `8B.7`.
- [Indonesia's Climate Ambitions Gain Boost Through World Bank-Supported Land Administration and Spatial Planning Reform](https://www.worldbank.org/en/news/press-release/2024/09/30/indonesia-s-climate-ambitions-gain-boost-through-world-bank-supported-land-administration-and-spatial-planning-reform) - World Bank, 2024-09-30. Claim: the reform package directly addressed tenure, licensing, spatial planning, and disputes, which is evidence of policy correction toward known bottlenecks. IDs: `8B.8`, also `8B.2`, `8B.6`.
- [Less burden, better care: MoH and WHO accelerate JKN redistribution](https://www.who.int/indonesia/id/news/detail/29-10-2024-less-burden--better-care--moh-and-who-accelerate-jkn-redistribution) - WHO Indonesia, 2024-10-29. Claim: the health ministry and WHO used workload ratios, quality standards, monitoring, and patient choice to rebalance care across providers, which is explicit course correction. IDs: `8B.8`, also `8B.5`, `8B.6`.
- [Indonesia ramps up capacities to detect and respond to outbreaks of emerging and epidemic-prone diseases](https://www.who.int/indonesia/news-room/item/30-08-2024-indonesia-ramps-up-capacities-to-detect-and-respond-to-outbreaks-of-emerging-and-epidemic-prone-diseases) - WHO Indonesia, 2024-08-30. Claim: nationwide rapid-response training in 514 districts is evidence of adapting implementation when preparedness gaps are recognized. IDs: `8B.8`, also `8B.5`, `8B.6`.
- [Indonesia's Golkar party picks influential Jokowi's top loyalist as leader](https://theprint.in/world/indonesias-golkar-party-picks-influential-jokowis-top-loyalist-as-leader/2231679/) - Reuters via ThePrint, 2024-08-21. Claim: Jokowi’s network could still move party machinery to preserve influence, showing active adjustment and control, though in a patronage-heavy way. IDs: `8B.8`, also `8B.5`, `8B.3`.
- [Outgoing Indonesian president gives cabinet jobs to loyalists of successor Prabowo](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/outgoing-indonesian-president-widodo-names-prabowo-aides-to-cabinet-3576652) - Reuters via Investing.com, 2024-08-19. Claim: Jokowi reshuffled cabinet staffing to smooth transition and preserve governability, which is a form of tactical adaptation even if not purely meritocratic. IDs: `8B.8`, also `8B.4`, `8B.5`, `8B.3`.

**Negative / limited correction**
- [Bulk of Indonesia data hit by cyber attack not backed up, officials say](https://www.asia-pacific-solidarity.net/news/2024-06-28/bulk-indonesia-data-hit-cyber-attack-not-backed-officials-say.html) - Reuters via APSN, 2024-06-28. Claim: the underlying failure was weak preparedness, and the response was reactive rather than evidence of strong learning before the shock hit. IDs: `8B.8`, also `8B.5`.
- [Reuters reported that much of the affected data had not been backed up](https://tech.yahoo.com/business/articles/bulk-indonesia-data-hit-cyberattack-075758741.html) - Reuters, 2024-06-28. Claim: the cyberattack exposed serious readiness failure, so correction existed but came after damage, not as robust anticipatory adaptation. IDs: `8B.8`, also `8B.5`.
- [Reuters reported layoffs and fewer job opportunities squeezing the middle class](https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/indonesias-dwindling-middle-class-seen-dimming-economic-outlook-3610865) - Reuters, 2024-09-11. Claim: macro stability did not fully translate into resilient household security, suggesting partial failure to reallocate toward more effective growth channels. IDs: `8B.8`, also `8B.7`.
- [HRW: Indonesia - Racism, discrimination against indigenous Papuans](https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/09/18/indonesia-racism-discrimination-against-indigenous-papuans) - Human Rights Watch, 2024-09-18. Claim: in Papua, abuses and weak accountability persisted, which is strong evidence against meaningful correction of security-force tactics or discipline. IDs: `8B.8`, also `8B.5`, `8B.7`.
- [Indonesia: U.S. Department of State report on 2024](https://www.ecoi.net/en/document/2128570.html) - U.S. Department of State, published 2025-08-12, covers 2024. Claim: the government did not systematically investigate or punish abuses in Papua, so ineffective implementers were not clearly replaced or reined in. IDs: `8B.8`, also `8B.5`, `8B.7`.
- [World Bank Group debars PT LPPSLH Konsultan](https://www.worldbank.org/en/news/press-release/2024/07/10/world-bank-group-debars-pt-lppslh-konsultan) - World Bank, 2024-07-10. Claim: favoritism and weak procurement discipline persisted inside a Jokowi-era project, indicating incomplete correction inside implementing agencies. IDs: `8B.8`, also `8B.4`, `8B.5`.
- [Analysis: A decade of Jokowi... leaves illiberal legacy, critics say](https://theprint.in/world/analysis-a-decade-of-jokowi-indonesias-democracy-icon-leaves-illiberal-legacy-critics-say/2310394/) - Reuters via ThePrint, 2024-10-14. Claim: end-of-term analysis emphasizes patronage, dynastic politics, and weaker institutional integrity, which cuts against a clean story of reforming ineffective political methods. IDs: `8B.8`, also `8B.5`, `8B.6`, `8B.7`.

**Search gap**
- I did not find a whole-of-government 2024 performance review showing systematic replacement of failing officials across ministries or security services.
- The strongest correction evidence is sector-specific and reactive: cyber incidents, macro policy, health system redistribution, and some administrative reforms.
- The weakest area remains Papua and politically entangled institutions, where the record shows continuity of coercive practice more than course correction.
